Resolution /

Title
Tampa Heights Riverfront CRA - A Resolution of the Community 
Redevelopment Agency of the City of Tampa, Florida, approving the contract 
with subcontractor by and among the Community Redevelopment Agency of 
the City of Tampa, Florida (“CRA”), Dulk Studio S.L. (“subcontractor”), and the 
City of Tampa, Florida (“City”), for the design, fabrication, and installation of a 
sculptural safety installation at the North Boulevard and Palm Avenue 
roundabout, located in part within the boundaries of the Tampa Heights 
Riverfront Community Redevelopment Area, for a contract price of 
$150,000.00, of which the CRA shall fund an amount not to exceed 
$100,000.00; authorizing execution of the contract by the CRA Chair and 
attestation by the CRA Secretary; providing an effective date.
BACKGROUND:
This project will be a fiberglass and galvanized steel structure drawn from the ecological 
wildlife of Tampa Heights. The project will enhance pedestrian and vehicular safety in this 
location.  The project will be adding a visual element that will slow traffic and bring awareness 
to the pedestrians in the area.   This project will also provide lighting for the area enhancing 
visibility to the roundabout.

Agency of the City of Tampa and Dulk Studio S.L. for the Tampa Heights Roundabout Project 
in the amount of $150,000 for the Tampa Heights Riverfront CRA within the Community 
Redevelopment Agency CRA Tampa Heights Riverfront Fund.
